title: DetectorManifestV1 — unsigned body hashed as closure.manifestDigest
description: Body identity-model.v3 hashes as closure.manifestDigest: admitted component manifest body under the security metadata profile, excluding the signature envelope. compatibleClosures is this detector's declaration that listed closure2 identities are exactly semantically compatible at the same semanticsMajor (workflows-and-surfaces §2). This schema is not a signature envelope and this projector does not verify signatures. Current-trust receipt is host.closures[closureId].trust=admitted, which the host derives from retained generation, an installed signed release with the same closure2, or a signed closureBundle. Caller compatibleWith maps are never this listing.
